meta.title: Hindsight memory & budget governor
meta.description: Self-contained Hindsight project memory engine, token-budgeted governor, and diagnostics for DSH — works as a single plugin without requiring @vectorize-io/hindsight-coding-agents. When the external bundle is absent or disabled (`memoryLane: auto`), this plugin directly provides pages/recall/reflect injection, automatic secret-redacted session retention, native page/recall/reflect/retain tools (`hindsight_search_pages`, `hindsight_list_pages`, `hindsight_read_page`, `hindsight_recall`, `hindsight_reflect`, `hindsight_retain`), and `/hindsight pages|recall|retain|seed` commands. When the external bundle is active, it automatically steps back to outer budget governance and diagnostics without double-injecting. It caps per-turn injection at `maxInjectTokens` (default 3000) with fast or built-in calibrated BPE accounting, adaptive/scenario tiers, repeat/delta deduplication, compaction re-entry, and evidence framing, and writes a lean profile to `~/.hindsight/coding-agent.json` on first session (fill-missing-only with backup and exact `/hindsight revert`).
